objective: The portable v3 grant chain and its admission receipt: the closed Rust populations are release-accountable through a fail-empty wrapper.
falsifiable_claim: npm run check:portable-v3-grant-chain pins seven families by exact name — wallet portable-authority service (12) and state (3), daemon portable-authority intent (9), final-invocation claim (6), SCM-scope (2), capability client (2) and SCM publication (25) — and refuses any missing, extra, ignored or renamed member.
adversarial_or_fault_proof: npm run mutate:portable-v3-grant-chain plants (a) an absent test name, refused by the source binding; (b) a name whose fn exists but whose module path the harness cannot list, refused at --list; (c) an empty population, refused outright — the wrapper proves it can fail on its own finding before it is trusted green.
remaining_nonclaims: The wrapper proves the pinned tests execute and pass; it does not widen what those tests assert. The unit's acceptance clauses are proven only to the extent the pinned tests prove them.
A CI floor is not yet pinned for these root-workspace wrappers; verifier-floors.v1.json covers hypervisor-app journey verifiers only.
